description_en: Queries the Internet service provider (ISP) information about a volumetric attack
description_zh: 查询某次流量型攻击的攻击来源网络运营商（ISP）信息
name: DescribeDDosEventIsp

parameters.help_en:
The type of the attack event that you want to query. Valid values:

defense: attack events that trigger traffic scrubbing
blackhole: attack events that trigger blackhole filtering
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的攻击事件类型。取值：

defense：流量型攻击清洗事件。
blackhole：流量型攻击黑洞事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The UNIX timestamp when the query starts. Unit: seconds.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188604.html operation to query the beginning time of all attack events
parameters.help_zh:
要查询事件的开始时间戳，单位：秒。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473646.html查询所有事件的开始时间信息
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the attacked Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_zh: 返回的数据量， 单位：条
